entries.description: Continuation of a listing from the previous page for 2 lesbian women on 93 acres of woods with camping space. It welcomes future new members or residents, girl children, and non-lesbian women, and bans drugs, alcohol, and tobacco.
entries.raw_text: We welcome: new members/residents (in future), girl children, nonlesbian women. No drugs, alcohol, tobacco. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 93 acres, camping space, woods.

Num residents left blank because the text on this page says 'We have/are: 2 lesbians' without stating they live on the land. entries.description: A feminist retreat and educational center in Orland, Maine on 10 acres of woods with housing, camping space, and a bio-dynamic garden, where women live and work on the land. From spring to fall it offers residential courses, retreats, workshops, internships, and artist residencies for lesbian women and non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: HARDSCRABBLE HILL CENTER Box 130-Castine Rd, Orland, ME 04472 (207)469-7112. From Spring to Fall our intensive residential courses and retreats for women expand the heart, challenge thinking, and offer practical tools and experience. We welcome: new members/residents, workshop participants, workshop guides, internships-apprentices, staff, private retreatants, artists in residence. We welcome all wild women, whatever stage or age on the feminist journey, creating new names as we go. We have: 10 acres of land adjoining several hundred wild, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity in some buildings, camping space, woods, bio-dynamic garden, women living and workin' the land.
entries.notes: Land address copied from street/road mailing address ('Box 130-Castine Rd, Orland, ME 04472') as women are 'living and workin' the land'. Acreage is 10 ('10 acres of land adjoining several hundred wild'; adjoining land not counted). Num residents is blank as no number is given for 'women living and workin' the land'. Type is Retreat/Gathering Space ('intensive residential courses and retreats for women', 'private retreatants'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women and Non-lesbian women from 'retreats for women' and 'We welcome all wild women, whatever stage or age on the feminist journey' (pre-1986 directory). Focuses: Workshops/education from 'intensive residential courses... workshop participants, workshop guides, internships-apprentices'; Archives/cultural work from 'artists in residence'; Farming/self-sufficiency from 'bio-dynamic garden, women living and workin' the land'.

entries.land_location_as_stated: surrounded by 100's of acres of unused, undeveloped land at present
entries.description: Private land in Dexter, Maine where a family of 2 lesbian women and 2 girl children live and work on 30 acres of woods with housing, trails, and camping space, including accessible roadside camping for disabled lesbian women. They do not smoke, drink, or use drugs, and welcome campers, non-lesbian women, girl children, and boy children by invitation only.
entries.raw_text: LINDA TISDALE/CAROL SHOREBORN RFD 2 Box 3085, Dexter, ME 04930 (207)924-5172. We are a small family of 2 lesbians, 2 girl children, 1 dog, 4 cats, 1 horse (soon to be more). We've cleared trails for hiking, picnics, camping, etc. Our 30 acres is surrounded by 100's of acres of unused, undeveloped land at present. We currently have no housing for other lesbian visitors but we welcome campers. Must be able to hike to campsite carry all needs in and out! Camping available near road for differently abled lesbians. We do not smoke, drink, use drugs. We welcome: girl children (boys by invitation only!), nonlesbian women, dogs. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 2 girl children, 30 acres of land, housing/permanent structures, electricity, well water, outhouse, camping space, woods, women living and workin' on the land.
entries.notes: Community name is the two women's names as printed at the start; also recorded in contact_name. Land address copied from rural route mailing address ('RFD 2 Box 3085, Dexter, ME 04930'). Acreage is 30 ('Our 30 acres is surrounded by 100's of acres of unused, undeveloped land'; surrounding land not counted). Num residents is 4 ('2 lesbians, 2 girl children... women living and workin' on the land'). Type is Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule ('We are a small family of 2 lesbians, 2 girl children'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women ('other lesbian visitors', '2 lesbians'); Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'); Girl children ('girl children'); Boy children ('(boys by invitation only!)'). Focuses: Disabled women from 'Camping available near road for differently abled lesbians'; Recovery/substance-free from 'We do not smoke, drink, use drugs'.

entries.description: A retreat and healing space on 143 uphill acres in Alpine, New York offering primitive camping, two swimming ponds, and a sauna in progress for lesbian women, where work is welcomed and chemicals are discouraged.
entries.raw_text: NORTHWOODS RD 1 Box 156, Alpine, NY 14805. This is additional info to our listing in VI,2. We can offer retreat and healing space mostly in the form of primitive camping - $2 to $5 a day if you can. Our accessibility is unfortunately poor (143 acres almost all uphill.) We'll probably have a visitor kitchen so please bring your own food, the sauna is in progress and both ponds are fine for swimming. Work is welcomed. Chemicals are discouraged.
entries.notes: Land address copied from rural route mailing address ('RD 1 Box 156, Alpine, NY 14805'). Type is Retreat/Gathering Space ('We can offer retreat and healing space mostly in the form of primitive camping'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women inferred because this is a listing in the questionnaire land directory welcoming visitors. Focus: Environmentalism/eco-friendly from 'Chemicals are discouraged'. Poor accessibility noted ('Our accessibility is unfortunately poor').

entries.description: A 20-acre farm between Harrisburg and Gettysburg in Dillsburg, Pennsylvania with a house, barn, woods, pasture, cows, chickens, bees, fruit trees, and garden, lived on by 1 lesbian woman homesteader and farmer. She is not a separatist, welcomes lesbian women and non-lesbian women for short visits with work exchange, and bans drugs, cigarettes, pets, and guns.
entries.raw_text: ONEIDA FARM RD 5, Dillsburg, PA 17019 (717)432-2157. (Between Harrisburg and Gettysburg.) I am a homesteader/farmer/carpenter on 20 acres with cows (beef and milk), chickens, bees, fruit trees, garden I am not a separatist and cannot accomodate flag-waving, breast-baring sisters. Visits (limited to 2-3 days) require work exchange. No drugs, cigarettes, pets, guns. Visitors are expected to bring own food, etc. Non-lesbian women welcome. I prefer that you telephone so that we get to know each other before we set up a visit. I have a house, barn, electricity, woods, farmland, pasture.
entries.notes: Land address copied from rural route mailing address ('RD 5, Dillsburg, PA 17019'). Num residents is 1 ('I am a homesteader/farmer/carpenter on 20 acres... I have a house'). Type is Private/Individual Land (one woman living on and hosting her own farm). Accepted groups: Lesbian women (questionnaire directory welcoming visitors) and Non-lesbian women ('Non-lesbian women welcome'). Rejects lesbian separatism ('I am not a separatist and cannot accomodate flag-waving, breast-baring sisters'). Focuses: Farming/self-sufficiency from 'homesteader/farmer/carpenter on 20 acres with cows (beef and milk), chickens, bees, fruit trees, garden'; Recovery/substance-free from 'No drugs, cigarettes'.

entries.description: A feminist women's community and retreat center on 35 acres in a land trust in Freeland, Maryland, 35 miles north of Baltimore, with 4 lesbian women, 6 buildings, organic gardens, bees, wood and solar heat, and camping. It welcomes visitors and new members, including lesbian women, non-lesbian women, and girl and boy children.
entries.raw_text: HEATHCOTE WOMENS COMMUNITY 21300 Heathcote Rd, Freeland, MD 21053 (301)343-1070. We are a new wom'ns community/retreat center, 35 miles north of Baltimore. We have/are: 4 lesbians with a feminist perspective, support for political involvement, strong ties with Baltimore wom'ns community, 35 acres of woods, meadow, stream in a land trust, 6 buildings, organic gardens, bees, wood and solar heat, electricity/plumbing, camping and indoor space. We are developing the retreat center (facilities for up to 50) as a business to support the place and members. Local jobs are possible with wom'n landscaping company, wom'ns printing shop. Long and short term commitment. We welcome: visitors, new members, all women of all colours and persuasions, girl and boy children. It's a wonderful place and we want to share it!
entries.notes: Land address copied from street address ('21300 Heathcote Rd, Freeland, MD 21053'). Type is Land Trust because the codebook states: 'Land the listing says is held "in a land trust" is Land Trust, whatever else the listing calls itself' ('35 acres of woods, meadow, stream in a land trust'). Num residents is 4 ('We are a new wom'ns community... We have/are: 4 lesbians... 6 buildings... to support the place and members'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women and Non-lesbian women from 'all women of all colours and persuasions' (also inclusiveness statement noted); Girl children and Boy children from 'girl and boy children'. Focuses: Farming/self-sufficiency from 'organic gardens, bees'; Environmentalism/eco-friendly from 'solar heat' and 'organic gardens'. Note: 'wom'ns printing shop' is mentioned as a local job possibility rather than on the land itself.

entries.community_name: WE DON'T HAVE A NAME YET
entries.land_location_as_stated: Between Berkeley Springs, WV and Winchester, VA.
entries.description: Private 20-acre land near Unger, West Virginia (between Berkeley Springs, WV and Winchester, VA) with woods, farmland, camping space, and a passive solar house lived on by 2 lesbian women musicians who aim for small-scale farming. They ban drugs, tobacco, and heavy drinking, and welcome lesbian women, non-lesbian women, supervised girl and boy children, and gay and non-gay men.
entries.raw_text: WE DON'T HAVE A NAME YET c/o Nan and Ruth, PO Box 63, Unger, WV 25447 (304)258-5079. (Between Berkeley Springs, WV and Winchester, VA.) We own 20 acres on which we built a passive solar shell this summer with the help of friends. We have to work away from the land at this point, but one of us is trying to find local work to be able to be more in touch with the land (small-scale farming and a few farm animals are a short-range goal). We are musicians & especially welcome non-competitive musicians and singers. We welcome: non-lesbian wimmin, girl & boy children (parental supervision a must), males, medium to small dogs (females only, please). Bring food to share. No drugs, tobacco, or heavy drinkers. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 20 acres, housing & permanent structures, electricity, camping space, woods, farmland, a male dog (does not get along with other male dogs), wimmin living (full time) and working (part time) on the land.
entries.notes: Contact address is a PO Box ('PO Box 63, Unger, WV 25447'), so land_street_address and land_zip are blank; land_city is Unger and land_state is WV as Unger is located right between Berkeley Springs, WV and Winchester, VA where the residents live full time. Num residents is 2 ('We have/are: 2 lesbians... wimmin living (full time) and working (part time) on the land'). Type is Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule ('c/o Nan and Ruth... We own 20 acres... 2 lesbians'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women ('2 lesbians', questionnaire directory); Non-lesbian women ('non-lesbian wimmin'); Girl children and Boy children ('girl & boy children (parental supervision a must)'); Gay men and Non-gay men from 'males'. Focuses: Environmentalism/eco-friendly from 'built a passive solar shell'; Farming/self-sufficiency from '(small-scale farming and a few farm animals are a short-range goal)'; Archives/cultural work from 'We are musicians & especially welcome non-competitive musicians and singers'; Recovery/substance-free from 'No drugs, tobacco, or heavy drinkers'.

entries.description: An intentional community of 3 to 5 women on 55 acres in hilly southeastern Ohio in Guysville, with a house, a barn, a second house under construction, goats, gardens, woods, a pond, farmland, and camping space. They welcome lesbian women, non-lesbian women, and girl and boy children for up to a week in exchange for help with food and work.
entries.raw_text: MOON RIDGE Rt 1 Box 240, Guysville, OH 45735. We are 3-5 wimmin on 55 acres in hilly southeastern Ohio. We have a house with electricity and a barn and another house under construction. We have dogs, cats, goats, gardens, woods, pond, camping space, farmland, wimmin living and working on and off the land. We welcome wimmin and children to stay up to a week for help with food and work exchange (house remodeling - house building - daily survival chores).
entries.notes: Land address copied from rural route mailing address ('Rt 1 Box 240, Guysville, OH 45735'). Num residents is 3, the smaller number of the range '3-5 wimmin on 55 acres... wimmin living and working on and off the land'. Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative (3-5 women living together on the land). Accepted groups: Lesbian women and Non-lesbian women from 'We welcome wimmin' (pre-1986 directory); Girl children and Boy children from 'and children'. Focus: Farming/self-sufficiency from 'goats, gardens... farmland'.

entries.description: Private land of 3+ acres in northern Minnesota near Iron and Virginia, lived on by 1 lesbian woman, with a house, camping space, an organic garden, a sauna, woods, and access to a small lake. It welcomes lesbian women and non-lesbian women of all ages for visits with work exchange or cash.
entries.raw_text: WHISPERING WINDS Rt 2 Box 8, Iron, MN 55751 (near Virginia). Country living with privacy for womyn. Located in Northern Minnesota, ten miles from town - access to a small lake. Company of womyn of all ages welcomed. Dogs if restrained. Visits require work exchange and/or cash. I am/have: 1 lesbian, 3+ acres, house/permanent structures, electricity, well, camping space, organic garden, sauna, 2 dogs, cat, woods.
entries.notes: Land address copied from rural route mailing address ('Rt 2 Box 8, Iron, MN 55751'). Acreage is 3 ('3+ acres'). Num residents is 1 ('Country living... I am/have: 1 lesbian, 3+ acres, house/permanent structures'). Type is Private/Individual Land ('I am/have: 1 lesbian'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women and Non-lesbian women from 'Company of womyn of all ages welcomed' (pre-1986 directory) and '1 lesbian'. Focus: Farming/self-sufficiency from 'organic garden'.
